newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - SAN JUAN COUNTY SD, UTAH.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - SAN JUAN COUNTY SD, UTAH.

text.p: Board of Education of San Juan County School District,
Sealed bids for the purchase of $6,560,000 General
Obligation School Building and Refunding Bonds, Series 1997 (the
Bonds''), of the Board of Edun County School District, San Juan County, Utah (the
Board'') will be received up to 10:00 A.M., M.D.T., on

at the offices of the Board at 200 North Main Street, in Blanding, Utah 84511. The Bonds will be dated September 1, 1997, and will mature serially on July 1 of each of the years and in the principal amounts as follows:

Interest will be payable commencing on January 1, 1998, and semiannually thereafter on January 1 and July 1 in each year, at a rate or rates per annum, not exceeding seven and one-half percent (7.50%) per annum to be fixed at the time the bonds are sold. The Bonds will be issued in registered form, and, when issued, will be registered in the name of The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York, or its nominee. The Depository Trust Company will act as securities depository for the Bonds. Purchases of beneficial interests in the Bonds will be made in book-entry form only in the denomination of $5,000 or any natural multiple thereof. The Bonds are being offered subject to the approval of legality by Ray, Quinney &Nebeker, Bond Counsel, and certain other conditions.

Copies of the OFFICIAL NOTICE OF BOND SALE, the OFFICIAL STATEMENT, bid forms, and other related information with respect to the Bonds, may be obtained from the Board's Financial Advisor, First Security Bank, N.A., at 41 East 100 South, Suite 300, in Salt Lake City, Utah 84111, telephone (801) 246-5598, facsimile transmission (801) 246-5973 or from the undersigned Business Administrator at his office, 200 North Main Street, in Blanding, Utah 84511, telephone (801) 678-1264, facsimile transmission (801) 678-1280.
